verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies public pricing. A pricing page exists at mistral.ai/pricing, but the cited excerpt covers open-weights licensing rather than rates. The docs give pricing relative to a standard rate: cached prompt tokens cost 10% of the standard input token price, batch runs at a 50% discount, and Labs models are free. Community posts cite concrete figures, such as OCR at $1/1000 pages and Ministral Large at about 1/10th the cost of Sonnet. Missing for 10: a documented per-token input/output price table covering every current model, explicit confirmation that pricing is self-serve with no sales contact required, and independent corroboration of the published rates.
